provenance: Live reads on 2026-09-25: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config (section 'Context window and auto-compaction'), https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference (autoCompactWindow), https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars (CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW, CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE), https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview (context windows), https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (no long-context premium on 4.6 and later), and the Claude Code CHANGELOG (2.1.247: Sonnet 5 compacts at about 967K; 2.1.260: Opus and Fable compact shortly before 1M).
note: Context windows and default auto-compact thresholds as DATA, read by scripts/lib/cache-advisor.mjs. There is ONE auto-compact window setting (autoCompactWindow in settings, the --autocompact flag, or CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW), not one per model; Claude Code caps it at each model's context window. Unset, a model compacts at its defaultCompactAt. Keys match config/model-pricing.json's aliases and are matched in the order written, first match wins. A local copy of this shape at ~/.claude/agent-companion/compaction.json is merged over it by alias, the same convention as model-pricing.json.
defaultsNote: defaultCompactAt 967000 is the documented 'about 967K tokens' for native-1M models on the Anthropic API; 200000 is the documented '200K boundary' for 200K models (measured auto-compactions on this kind of model land a little under it). A model matching no entry is treated as a 200K model.
minTurnsNote: Compaction loses detail, and that loss is not priced. A candidate window is only recommended when the replay compacts no more often than once every this many turns (a turn is a prompt or a SendMessage that starts work), measured per model as requests per turn in main sessions.

planUsage.note: Secondary view only. Plan usage (subscription limits) is assumed proportional to API price except where a weight is given here, relative to that model's API price. Opus 5.5 counted 1.5x Sonnet 5 in the plan usage tooltip on 2026-09-23 while its API price is 2x, so its weight is 0.75. This may be introductory; re-check before relying on it.
